source: F1*U ligase-ribozyme fitness landscape (Rotrattanadumrong et al 2022, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6945203); 35nt catalytic-core; Mean_RA=replicate-mean relative ligase activity (fraction-ligated/WT); 'Combinatorially complete' 2^16 mutational hypercube subset (systematic enumeration, NO algorithm selection -> no generator confound); single RNA-ligase mechanism, no perturbation arm
cannot_claim: combinatorial 2^16 hypercube around WT -> Hamming-neighbor leakage: random split leaks near-duplicates -> HAMMING-CLUSTER holdout (whole near-neighbor clusters held out)
y=log2(Mean_RA+0.05) handles dead variants (RA=0) as low activity; RA is fraction-ligated relative to WT
structure tested for incremental over composition + mutation-load (HD_WT); combinatorial enumeration means NO generator/selection confound (unlike model-generated design pools)
NEW engine boundary-map contact (RNA fold/structure -> ligase activity beyond composition in a mutational hypercube), NOT a new mechanism
